description.value: I&J Fusion is a family-owned Pan Asian restaurant in Creston, BC, run by Isabel and John, who make all sauces, noodles, and desserts from scratch using fresh, local ingredients. The dining room offers views of the surrounding mountains and valley, giving touring cyclists a scenic stop in the Kootenays. The menu spans lunch and dinner with a range of fusion Asian dishes, bubble tea, and a strong selection of gluten-free, dairy-free, and vegetarian options.
